annotations.title: Statistics of numbers: mean, median, standard deviation, percentiles

description: Descriptive statistics for a list of numbers: count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, range, population and sample variance and standard deviation, quartiles with IQR, and the 90th, 95th and 99th percentiles (linear interpolation). Up to 10,000 numbers, comma or space separated. Use to summarise measurements, latencies, prices or scores without a spreadsheet. Example: values=12, 15, 15, 18, 21, 24, 30, 45.
